channels_live_owner_required.name: channels_live_owner_required
channels_live_owner_required.value: "channels"."origin" != 'live_twitch' OR ("channels"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "channels"."twitch_channel_id" IS NOT NULL)

channels_connection_owner_required.name: channels_connection_owner_required
channels_connection_owner_required.value: "channels"."connected_at" IS NULL OR ("channels"."owner_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "channels"."twitch_channel_id" IS NOT NULL)

open_loops_terminal_reason.name: open_loops_terminal_reason
open_loops_terminal_reason.value: "open_loops"."status" NOT IN ('fulfilled', 'cancelled') OR length(trim("open_loops"."last_reason")) > 0 AND "open_loops"."last_reason" IS NOT NULL
